sources.snippet: LFM2 is a new generation of hybrid models developed by Liquid AI and available in 3 variants - 350M, 700M, 1.2B. LFM2.5 is an updated version with improved training (28T tokens vs 10T) and extended context length support (32K tokens).

sources.title: Introducing LFM2: The Fastest On-Device Foundation Models on the Market ...
sources.snippet: Today, we release LFM2, a new class of Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs) that sets a new standard in quality, speed, and memory efficiency for on-device deployment. Built on a hybrid architecture, LFM2 delivers 200% faster decode and prefill performance than Qwen3 and Gemma 3 on CPU.
